description: This file contains functions for configuring and handling trigger shapes and engine cycle calculations in an engine control system, including specific trigger configurations and event scheduling based on engine operation modes.

methods.name: getEngineCycle
methods.description: Returns the engine cycle angle based on the operation mode (two-stroke or four-stroke).

methods.name: addSkippedToothTriggerEvents
methods.description: Adds trigger events for teeth on a trigger wheel, accounting for skipped teeth and engine cycle.

methods.name: initializeSkippedToothTriggerShapeExt
methods.description: Initializes a trigger shape with skipped teeth, setting synchronization and shape errors.

methods.name: configureOnePlusOne
methods.description: Configures trigger events for a specific engine trigger pattern with primary and secondary events.

methods.name: configureOnePlus60_2
methods.description: Configures trigger events for a 60-tooth wheel with skipped teeth, specific timing, and filters.

methods.name: configure3_1_cam
methods.description: Configures trigger events for a 3/1 cam trigger pattern with multiple event schedules.
